Sort by start; group cars that catch up. O(n log n).

For car fleet basic I will compute arrival times then group.

```python
def car_fleet(target, pos, speed):
    cars = sorted(zip(pos, speed), reverse=True)
    fleets = 0
    slowest = 0
    for p, s in cars:
        t = (target - p) / s
        if t > slowest:
            fleets += 1
            slowest = t
    return fleets
```
